name: WILDLIFE
tagline: The secret intelligence of the living world.
description: The behavior, survival strategies, and hidden cognitive lives of Earth's most extraordinary species.

name: PLANET
tagline: Geological forces, deep currents, and shifting ecosystems.
description: Oceans, climate dynamics, tectonic frontiers, and the ancient planetary systems shaping our living biosphere.

name: SCIENCE
tagline: Discoveries redefining the boundaries of reality.
description: Frontier physics, neurobiology, synthetic genomics, and the fundamental questions of matter and consciousness.

name: SPACE
tagline: The cosmological expanse beyond our pale blue dot.
description: Exoplanetary atmospheres, stellar evolution, radio astronomy, and humanity's silent voyage through the cosmos.

name: HISTORY
tagline: Lost civilizations and stories buried beneath millennia.
description: Submerged cities, LiDAR archaeology, forgotten empires, and the long evolutionary journey of human ingenuity.

name: CULTURE
tagline: Living traditions, indigenous wisdom, and modern diaspora.
description: Rituals of remote communities, sonic languages, nomadic identities, and the shifting mosaic of human heritage.

name: EXPLORATION
tagline: Journeys to the geographic and psychological edges.
description: Speleology in unmapped caverns, polar transits, volcanic descents, and endurance at the extremes of Earth.

name: PHOTOGRAPHY
tagline: Visual narratives that capture the raw truth of existence.
description: Extraordinary visual essays from field photojournalists, remote optical expeditions, and macro naturalists.
